tx_little_new_wall.blurb: Little New Wall is a bouldering wall inside Rogers Park, the limestone bouldering spot on Lake Belton in central Texas. Ten problems are climbed here, running from V0 up to V5, with the bulk of them in the V1 to V4 range, so a mixed group can find something. The wall is tall and blocky, with ferns growing on it, and the features give a pocketed, steep style typical of this park. You walk to it along the trail, passing three other walls on the way; a chest-high window shape near the far end helps you spot several lines. The park as a whole is mostly shaded, which suits warm days.

tx_split_malice_boulders.blurb: A pair of boulders on the front side of North Mountain at Hueco Tanks, below the Central Wall. The larger one, Split Boulder, is about 20 feet tall with problems on every side, so you can usually find sun or shade at any time of day; a big cleaved crack makes it easy to pick out. The smaller Malice boulder sits beneath a well-known bolted line and has a few problems facing north and northwest. The ten problems here are mostly easy to moderate, V0 through about V4, which makes it a good place to warm up or bring newer boulderers, plus one extremely hard line at the top end.

tx_stegasaur_the.blurb: The Stegasaur is a small boulder cluster on North Mountain at Hueco Tanks, in far west Texas near El Paso. It holds ten problems and leans toward the difficult end: a couple of easy ones, then a steady run of hard problems from V6 through V10, with the namesake line rated about V7. It is not a warm-up spot, so bring some skin and a few friends to spot. North Mountain approaches are generally short, and the hill is the part of the park where climbers can roam on their own.

tx_beehives_the.blurb: The Beehives is a small bouldering area on East Mountain at Hueco Tanks, just east of Tabloid Pass. It has ten problems, most of them easy to moderate: V0 through V4, with one V6 that is the area's standout. Because the grades are friendly and the spot is warm and catches morning sun, it works well as a first stop for the day. East Mountain as a whole is a larger zone of roughly 160 problems, with plenty of shelter from sun, wind and rain tucked into other corners.
